description: Ohmentum card: college-level electrical engineering online

backFields.label: About
backFields.value: A complete, college-level electrical engineering curriculum: 25 courses from circuits to power systems, RF and VLSI, with worked examples, auto-graded problems, quizzes, exams and study sheets.

backFields.label: Plans
backFields.value:
Free: the first lesson of every course.
Monthly: $29/month, cancel anytime.
Annual: $249/year (save 28%).
Founding Member: $15/month or $129/year, locked in while you stay subscribed, while spots last.

backFields.label: Note
backFields.value: Ohmentum is an independent learning platform, not an accredited institution.
